name: Together AI serverless inference
price_basis: USD per 1M TOKENS, representative model meta-llama/Llama-3.3-70B serverless list price, observed 2026-10-14 ($1.04 input = $1.04 output, symmetric). Not the cheapest rate on the page: gpt-oss-120b is $0.15/$0.60, Qwen3-235B FP8 is $0.20/$0.60, GLM-5.3-Flash $0.15/$0.50, Llama-3-8B-Instruct-Lite $0.14/$0.14. Cached input is a separate lower price where offered (e.g. MiniMax M3 $0.30/$0.06-cached/$1.20). Dedicated endpoints and GPU clusters are priced per-hour separately; batch API has its own column on the same page.
notes: 2026-10-16 measurement refresh. Artificial Analysis lists Together AI (Turbo) on Llama 3.3 70B at 79 output tok/s median and 1.50s median first chunk, context 131k. The previous measured pair (0.74s, 43 tok/s) was OpenRouter's 2026-10-14 P50 for the Together row and is a different traffic mix. The $1.04/$1.04 price is still the 2026-10-14 OpenRouter Together row; Together's own pricing page fetched 2026-10-16 is a long per-model catalog that did not surface a Llama 3.3 70B row in the extracted text, so the price was not moved. Measured figures are the OpenRouter routing table's 2026-10-14 P50 for Together's llama-3.3-70b endpoint (0.74s latency, 43 tok/s, 95.60% uptime) - third-party-measured over live traffic, matching the Artificial Analysis provider set which also benchmarks Together Turbo on this model. 43 tps is a SHARED-infrastructure number: Together's pitch is dedicated endpoints for higher single-stream speed, so the serverless figure is the floor. Models listed are a sample of a ~100-model catalog spelled as the repo's model slugs; provider-side ids are namespaced (meta-llama/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct-Turbo).
